findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 18 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 147 questions numbered 1-147; by section: 18.1 19, 18.2 24, 18.3 19, 18.4 7, 18.5 8, 18.6 18, 18.7 14, 18.8 9, 18.9 13, 18.10 16. Keys: {'a': 37, 'b': 36, 'c': 37, 'd': 37}.

Covers every section 18.1-18.10 in order (3d series and configurations, physical and chemical properties, variable oxidation states, catalysis, complexes and ligands, formula and charge of complex ions, geometry, d-orbital splitting and colour, ligand exchange of Cu(II) and Co(II), Kstab and the chelating effect, stereoisomerism, redox reactions). Every number (E°cell, mole ratios, titre volume, Kstab ratios, ΔE = hc/λ, oxidation states) was recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: E°(CO₂/C₂O₄²⁻) = −0.49 V and E°cell = +2.01 V, E°(Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺) = +0.77 V and E°cell = +0.75 V, balanced equations with 16H⁺/8H⁺, total ligand charge −6 in [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻, the ammonia complex of Cu(II) as [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺, [Cu(en)₃]²⁺ with its charge, and only two isomers for an [MA₄B₂] complex; the d⁷/d⁸/d¹⁰ tetrahedral list is not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
